profiles.name: derekldavis
profiles.profile: This is the kind of file you get when a guy keeps teeing it up like the fairway owes him money and then immediately misses the payment. The driver has flashes, but the whole operation keeps getting mugged by the irons and the short game before the card can stabilize. There is enough here to say the profile isn’t random—it’s repeatable self-sabotage with a golf club—but there was at least one round where the putter pretended to be a coworker and showed up to the meeting. When the ball is in play, he can look like he belongs; the problem is the rest of the hole usually arrives with a bat.
